name: 翻盖立片抽取湿巾款
description: 翻盖密封、抽出一片自立、绵柔厚实的婴儿手口湿巾套图

styleLock.backgroundSystem: bone linen weave #F4F1EC with soft natural folds shading into #9A8FA6, matte, low contrast, shallow depth so no pattern repeats across the frame
styleLock.lightingSystem: one large diffused key from front-top at 5200K, low contrast, broad soft fill, gentle elongated contact shadow under every object, no hard specular, calm spa-like mood
styleLock.surfaceSystem: pale oak wood tray #C9AE8C with quiet grain laid over bone linen #F4F1EC; every object rests on a real surface with a visible contact shadow and is never floating
styleLock.typography: a single humanist rounded sans-serif family at medium to semibold weight with generous letter spacing, never mixing serif, handwritten, retro or display faces
styleLock.iconSystem: rust-orange #B4593A solid dots threaded on a hairline #9A8FA6 line, evenly spaced, one dot per label, no filled shapes, no gradient icons, no emoji
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle for the pouch, product always centered on the oak tray at identical scale and placement across the set, verticals kept truly vertical, no cropped bottoms, no floating product, no duplicated product elements
noDrift: no color palette changes, keep #F4F1EC / #9A8FA6 / #4A4356 / #B4593A only
no mixed fonts, one rounded sans-serif family only
no random backgrounds, only bone linen #F4F1EC and pale oak tray #C9AE8C
no inconsistent lighting, always 5200K soft front-top low contrast
no mismatched icon styles, only a hairline line plus a rust-orange dot
no brand name, logo, wordmark, watermark, QR code or membership badge
no price, discount, coupon, shipping time, weight, size, capacity, sheet count or pH number
no material grade, origin, imported claim or patent count
no certification, award, test report, registration number or executive standard
no doctor, hospital or laboratory endorsement, no treatment or prevention claim, no age range, no material safety claim
no rating, sales volume or percentage comparison curve
no identifiable infant face, no infant alone in frame, a caregiver is always present
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent soft maternal-care ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of bone linen background #F4F1EC, lavender grey-purple secondary #9A8FA6, deep grey-purple text #4A4356 and one rust-orange accent #B4593A; neutral 5200K tone; one humanist rounded sans-serif family; consistent hairline plus rust-orange dot icon style; bone linen and pale oak wood surfaces; soft low-contrast front-top lighting with gentle contact shadows; stable product scale and centered placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 8 张源片（panel-01~08），归档于 _sources/母婴-湿巾 (7)。合并：panel-03/04 的重复物料说明合并为一屏俯视对照；panel-05/06 的配方卖点去重后归入配方说明屏。品类判定：源页为抽取式婴儿湿巾（翻盖盒装、单片抽出、绵柔无纺布），故判 母婴/洗护，与文件夹名一致。风格出处：色板与光感从源页包装的柔和粉调、亚麻质感与低反差前上方光感提炼，图标取源页圆点标体系。已剥离品牌字、会员二维码、销量与杀菌/荧光剂等功效数值。
